title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 9: New-Account Holdback on Hold-Release Payouts
content:
**9.1** When a payout hold on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account is lifted, a new-account holdback is kept back from the hold-release payout. It follows how many whole months the earnings account has been open on the day the hold is lifted, counted from its opened date:

(a) fewer than 6 whole months holds back 60.00;
(b) at least 6 but fewer than 12 whole months holds back 30.00;
(c) 12 whole months or more holds back nothing.

**9.2** The new-account holdback is taken off the available balance when the hold is lifted, in the same single deduction as anything else kept back from that payout and before the payout's single rounding; the amount kept back stays in the available balance and is paid with the next scheduled weekly payout.

## Clause 9.1 in a table

| Whole months open on the day the hold is lifted | New-account holdback (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | 60.00 |
| 6 to 11 | 30.00 |
| 12 or more | 0.00 |

## Edges of the bands (hypothetical accounts)

| Account open for | Holdback |
|---|---|
| 5 whole months, not yet 6 | 60.00 |
| Exactly 6 whole months | 30.00 |
| 11 whole months, not yet 12 | 30.00 |
| Exactly 12 whole months | 0.00 |

**Hypothetical figure.** For an account opened 8 whole months before the day its hold is lifted, with an available balance of 210.00, the new-account holdback is 30.00: that 30.00 is taken off the 210.00 in the hold-release payout and stays in the available balance for the next scheduled weekly payout.
